titre: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b6961c1537506d28be980279a7f5a1673a0521a6.jpg[/img]

Get ready: from [b]28th October to 18th November 2026[/b], NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in [b]eerie Halloween decorations[/b] and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! [b]Additional quests[/b] and a [b]title with powerful effects[/b] are also waiting for you!

[h1]Event Raids[/h1]

[h2]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h2]

Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.
Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

[h2]Foxy and Her Brood[/h2]

Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!
Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a powerful partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

[h2]Mad Professor Macavity[/h2]

The mad genius feline is back! Rally seven players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!
[b]Full details on the raid:[/b]

[list]
[*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.
[*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.
[*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.
[*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.
[*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.
[*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.
[*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time.
[*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.
[*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.
[*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.
[*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
[/list]

[h2]Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects[/h2]

In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:

[list]
[*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.
[*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.
[*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
[/list]

[h1]Daily Quests[/h1]

[h2]The Cursed 13[/h2]

Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

[h2]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/h2]

Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.

[list]
[*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.
[*]Don your Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.
[*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
[/list]

Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: Patch Notes – 19th Anniversary & Celestial Spire Catacombs Expansion
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg[/img]


[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*]The Celestial Spire Catacombs have been expanded with 10 new levels.[list]
	[*] The Token Shop has been updated and new rewards added.
	[*] New family quests and achievements have been added for the new levels.
	[*] The difficulty of levels 11–20 has been adjusted.[/list]
[*]Added a system to automatically upgrade item rarity level.[list]
	[*] Players can choose a target rarity level, and the system will automatically keep attempting upgrades until the level has been reached or the materials have been consumed.
	[*] This function is only possible with the new scrolls.[/list]
[*]Added an option to automatically upgrade equipment and specialist cards.
[*]Animations for upgrading rarity levels, equipment and specialist cards are now faster.
[*]Added a new character selection background, chosen from the recent Fan Art Contest.
[*]Updated the contents of the Raid Box of Grasslin. 
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the NosTale client from closing completely when quitting the game. (Note: The problem has numerous causes, and while the most common ones have now been resolved, it may still occur in certain circumstances.)
[*]Fixed an issue where your partner’s auto-attack cooldown could disrupt the cooldown of the skill bound to Shift+Q. This would continue until the SP transformation was cancelled and reapplied.
[*]Fixed an issue where the specialist partner skill bar was greyed out in unintended situations.
[*]The starting point for the Nezarun the Crusher raid has been changed to the originally intended coordinates (44, 14).
[*]Fixed an issue which arose when splitting a full stack from the raid inventory to the main inventory, whereby the slot in the wrong inventory was cleared, and the stack which was moved was displayed in the wrong inventory.
[*]Fixed an issue where hardcore raid medals would display a message about anniversary medals after expiring.
[*]Fixed an issue where medals would not expire correctly, and expiry messages would be sent to the chat every time the player logged in.
[*]General fixes for improved server stability.
[/list]

titre: 19 Years: Happy Birthday, NosTale!
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/32d6febac6df53d83f062ed7c52e63dc2f9f7fa0.jpg[/img]

Put on your party hats and light the candles: NosTale is celebrating its [b]19th birthday[/b]! Starting [b]7th October 2026[/b], we have a whole range of exciting events lined up for you in celebration of this special anniversary. Read on to discover what awaits.

[h2]New Levels for the Celestial Spire Catacombs[/h2]
There’s now even more to the Celestial Spire Catacombs! Look forward to 10 challenging new levels (21–30) to complete.

[h3]New Colour Schemes[/h3]
The levels 21 to 25 appear in a pastel green shade, while levels 26 to 30 get a pastel blue appearance, so you can recognise at a glance which section you’re in.

[h3]Challenges[/h3]
The expanded levels feature reworked versions of monsters familiar to Act 10, bringing new stats and of course presenting a much tougher challenge.

[h3]New Family Missions[/h3]
The milestones for levels 25 and 30 provide new daily and monthly missions. These include family attack and defence bonuses, additional fairy EXP, improved raid token chances, and huge amounts of family EXP.

[h2]Automatic Upgrade Attempts[/h2]
You can use the new system to automatically attempt upgrades to a desired rarity level (up to level 8). Level 7 is selected by default.

The system will keep attempting upgrades until:
[list][*]The desired rarity has been reached or exceeded[/*][*]The required materials have been used up[/*][*]No more matching items are available[/*][/list]
There will be two types of scroll:
[list][*]Champion Blessing Scroll (Random): Rarity, stats and effects may be changed.[/*][*]Champion Blessing Scroll (Fixed): Only the rarity changes, stats and effects remain unchanged.[/*][/list]
[h2]Automatically Upgrade Specialist Cards[/h2]
The update also introduces the ability to automatically upgrade gear and specialist cards without starting each attempt yourself.

It will keep attempting upgrades until either the upgrade succeeds or a required material has been exhausted. Before each attempt, the system checks whether all required materials and the matching upgrade item are present.

texte:

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]18/09 (11 AM) and 21/09 (11 AM CEST)[/b], you have a [b]50% improved chance (100% on Summer Oasis)[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: End of the Summer Oasis Server & Server Merge
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/66e8810e0ccdbea87ce920c2921465a9f4d588fd.jpg[/img]

The summer is drawing to a close, and with it our sunny event server. As previously announced when we launched the Summer Oasis server, there will be a server merge on [b]Wednesday, 30th September 2026[/b]. If you haven’t done so already, remember to select your destination server for the character transfer soon!

Enjoy the final days of summer and have fun playing!The NosTale Team

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How do I choose a server?[/h3]
The Battle Pass gives you access to a box with multiple items that allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item represents a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you have time until the Summer Oasis server closes to choose your destination server.

[h3]Are there any rules for transferring characters?[/h3]
You must select a destination server for your character transfer before the Summer Oasis server closes on Wednesday, 30th September 2026, after which point you will no longer be able to make a transfer.

If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to rename your character the first time you log in after the server merge.

If all the character slots on your chosen server are taken, your character will be deactivated. On the website, you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish:
[list][*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.[/*][*]Click on Settings to open your account settings.[/*][*]This takes you to the corresponding NosTale web page where you can view your character list.[/*][*]If you’ve got more than four characters, you can swap an active character for a deactivated one.[/*][/list]
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.

If you’re playing on Steam, you’ll need to link your Steam account with your Gameforge account in order to manage your active characters. [url=https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/348-from-steam-to-gameforge-how-to-link-accounts/]Click here[/url] to find out how it works.

[h3]What will be transferred and what won’t be?[/h3]
[b]Transfer includes:[/b]
[list][*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window), plus regular inventories and equipment inventories[/*][*]Raid and mount inventories[/*][*]Costumes, specialist card inventories and active NosMall items (e.g. Inventory Expansions,NosMerchant Medals).[/*][*]Your Miniland, including NosMates and decorations (including Partner’s Backpack).[/*][*]Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc.[/*][*]Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.[/*][*]Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your transferred character.[/*][*]All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the character transfer and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.[/*][*]As is standard, the destination servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 2,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the transfer, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server.[/*][/list]
[b]Transfer excludes:[/b]
[list][*]Families will not be transferred. The contents of family warehouses will be sent per parcel to the family heads.[/*][*]Inactive auctions must be collected before the server closes, otherwise the items will be deleted. If you’ve lost an item for this reason, please contact our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]support team[/url].[/*][*]Friends list, blacklist and marriages will be deleted or dissolved.[/*][/list]
[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]
No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials.

[h3]What happens to quest items I can’t receive again?[/h3]
Items that you require for quests or similar which are lost during the character transfer, and which cannot be re-acquired via the game mechanics or the NosMall, can be restored to you by our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]support team[/url]. Please get in touch if that’s the case.

titre: SP Balance & Quality of Life Adjustments - Patch notes
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg[/img]

Hello,

We know how important regular balancing updates for SPs are, particularly for the older ones, which is why they will be the focus of this update. Our larger SP balancing patches tend to have a particular emphasis, e.g. the last iteration focused on the 5th generation SPs.

That’s only partly the case this time round.  We’ve analysed which SPs have been under/overperforming for some time, and made changes specifically to these SPs. The update will also add a few quality-of-life improvements to the designs of certain SPs. Some buffs and debuffs have also received changes which were not part of the SP balancing measures. We hope these changes will provide for more all-round balanced gameplay in both PvE and PvP.

We’re also taking the opportunity to make a few smaller changes to the SP12.

[b]The following SPs have received changes:[/b]
[list][*]Ranger[/*][*]Blue Magician[/*][*]Gravity[/*][*]Battle Monk[/*][*]Avenging Angel[/*][*]Renegade[/*][*]Master Wolf[/*][*]Thunderer[/*][*]Smaller changes to SP12[/*][*]Smaller changes to various buffs & debuffs[/*][/list]
All changes can be found here: [url=https://nostale.comastuff.com/Guides/guides.php?id=72]https://nostale.comastuff.com/Guides/guides.php?id=72[/url]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list][*]The contents of raid boxes from Dr Dimensio’s raid have been updated.[/*][*]The contents of raid boxes from Lola Lopears’ raid have been updated.[/*][*]Healing effects can no longer be applied to Lord Mukraju.[/*][*]The effect ‘The cooldown time for reusing magic skills is reduced by x%.’ is now capped at 80%, and stacks with the ‘Reduces skill cooldowns by x% (max. 80%).’ effect.[/*][*]The obsolete Sheep Farm Raid Seal, Dodge Meteor Raid Seal and Bushi King Defence Raid Seal items are no longer awarded as rewards during the Valhalla quest series.[/*][*]The Godslayer quest from Act 7 now correctly awards the Simple Raid Box of Belial instead of the old raid box.[/*][/list]
More details can be found here: [url=https://nostale.comastuff.com/Guides/guides.php?id=73]https://nostale.comastuff.com/Guides/guides.php?id=73[/url]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug which could interrupt the Pet Trainer side quests.[/*][*]Fixed a bug which would erroneously mark The Catsy People Time-Space for new level-56 characters as completed.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the Achilles enemy in the Act 10.2 Secret Cave Time-Space could not be attacked with targetted skills.[/*][*]Fixed a bug which caused the daily Perpetual Death quest to be displayed as the Endless Cold quest in the accept window and quest log, despite having distinct names when being accepted from the NPC Captain Enrico.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the no-drop effect caused by the Dimension Sickness debuff was not applied to monsters whose loot lands directly in your inventory.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the glow effect from the Holy Floral Energy buff would shine through the floor and other objects.[/*][*]The Dimension Sickness debuff is no longer reapplied after changing maps during raids and Time-Spaces when starting on a map channel other than 0.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the drop rate reduction caused by the Dimension Sickness debuff did not apply to monsters defeated by NosMates.[/*][*]The special Beanie Hat reward item from the Final Showdown Time-Space is now correctly awarded to the player upon completion.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where clicking on a raid boss’ HP bar to target them would render the character unable to move.[/*][*]Fixed an error which caused lag whenever a new monster wave spawned in Time-Spaces and the Celestial Spire Catacombs.[/*][*]Fixed an error which made it possible to reduce the cooldown of skills beyond the 80% cap.[/*][*]Fixed an error which prevented using the basic attack of the second form of the Draconic Fist specialist after increasing job level.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the values were swapped in the effect ‘There is a x% chance that the enemy’s skill cooldown will be increased by x%.’[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the new Champion Blessing Scroll (Random, Guaranteed) which erroneously warned about the item failing.[/*][*]Fixed a visual bug which caused the chat to randomly erroneously display that items/gold had been obtained.[/*][*]Fixed a visual bug which could cause the Renegade specialist’s sword to appear oversized in certain circumstances.[/*][*]Fixed a visual bug where the damage from the red pillars of flames in the Belial raid was not displayed.[/*][*]Fixed a visual bug where the damage of the Body Bomb debuff was not displayed.[/*][*]Fixed a visual bug where the glow effect of the Obelisk of Light was not removed.[/*][/list]

[/p][list][*][p][b]Summer Oasis server starts[/b]: 19th August 2026
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summer Oasis server ends[/b]: 30th September 2026
[/p][/*][/list][h3]The Summer Oasis[/h3][p]
Dive in and enjoy a paradise of action! Look forward to the [b]following highlights[/b]:

[b][u]Boosts & weekend events[/u][/b]

During the entire Summer Oasis, you can look forward to increased experience points, and other permanent boosts.
Each weekend there are exclusive events with higher drop and enchantment chances, which will make your heroic journey even more exciting and worthwhile.

[b][u]Free Battle Pass[/u][/b]

Complete missions in the free Battle Pass to earn items which will support you on your adventures and accelerate your progress.

[b][u]Special Achievements[/u][/b]

For the most dedicated adventurers, the Summer Oasis offers additional challenges and achievements. These can be completed either alone or in a group, and reward you with exclusive items and titles.
In addition there are server-wide challenges for the entire community. Work together to complete these to unlock even better boosts during the weekend events!

[b][u]Summer Oasis Details[/u][/b]

You’ll find a complete FAQ at the bottom of this news post.

[/p][h2]Specialist Balancing[/h2][p]
The following specialist cards are getting a balancing update on [b]12th August 2026[/b] which will overhaul certain skills and effects:
[/p][list][*][p]Blue Magician
[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Monk
[/p][/*][*][p]Avenging Angel
[/p][/*][*][p]Renegade
[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s not all! Keep your eyes peeled for even more surprises. You’ll find details in the patch notes on 11th August 2026.

[/p][h2]Summer Event with Lola Lopears[/h2][p]
Ears up, adventurer! Our summer event series continues with part 2, where you’ll have to play it by ear against a wily band of bunnies in the hunt for wonderful rewards. Join the fun!
[/p][list][*][p][b]Event period[/b]: 12th August (11 AM) to 7th October (11 AM CEST).
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Give Lola’s Lopears a Boxing![/h3][p]
Look out, here comes Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid for 5 to 8 players – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find [b]Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card[/b] in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.
[b]What Else?[/b]
There are also lots of other missions that need your attention. In reward for your efforts, you can pick up the ‘Lopears’ title giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute Bunny Hairband, and a whole raft of other rewards.

[/p][h2]Summer Oasis Server FAQ[/h2][p]
Here’s a short FAQ about the Summer Oasis server:

[/p][h3]How long will the Summer Oasis server be online before I can transfer registered characters?[/h3][list][*][p]The Summer Oasis will be online for 6 weeks, from 19th August until 30th September 2026.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]What’s special about the Summer Oasis?[/h3][list][*][p]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the Summer Oasis server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
[/p][/*][*][p]Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer one character per account to a server of your choosing.
[/p][/*][*][p]Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. Don’t forget to register your character for the transfer!
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Which boosts will be available and when?[/h3][list][*][p]The following boosts will be permanently active on the Summer Oasis server:
[/p][/*][*][p]2x EXP
[/p][/*][*][p]4x Reputation (not in Act 4)
[/p][/*][*][p]2x XP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
[/p][/*][*][p]3x Fairy XP
[/p][/*][*][p]2x Drops
[/p][/*][*][p]3x Family XP
[/p][/*][*][p]In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/h3][list][*][p]Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the Summer Oasis server, albeit with lower boosts.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/h3][list][*][p]Yes, there will be a free Battle Pass for the Summer Oasis server. The pass will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
[/p][/*][*][p]The Battle Pass includes transfer items and other great rewards.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Will there be special server first challenges?[/h3][list][*][p]Yes, there will be special challenges and achievements to reward the most loyal and motivated adventurers with exclusive items.
[/p][/*][*][p]The achievements can be solo and party-based, where players will be rewarded with titles and many other great rewards. There’ll even be some server-wide challenges!
[/p][/*][/list][h3]How do I transfer my character?[/h3][list][*][p]Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]How do I choose a server?[/h3][list][*][p]There will be items in the Battle Pass that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item represents a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you have time until the Summer Oasis server closes to choose your destination server.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Where do I see which server I’ve selected?[/h3][list][*][p]You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Are there any rules for transferring?[/h3][p]
Certainly! The following rules apply:
[/p][list][*][p]You must select a server to transfer your character to before the Summer Oasis event server is closed on 30th September 2026, otherwise you won’t be able to transfer your character.
[/p][/*][*][p]If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the first time you log in after transferring.
[/p][/*][*][p]If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated. You can reactivate them in the standard manner via the website:
[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
[/p][/*][*][p]Click on Settings to open your account settings.
[/p][/*][*][p]This takes you to the corresponding NosTale web page where you can view your character list.
[/p][/*][*][p]If you’ve got more than four characters, you can swap an active character for a deactivated one.
[/p][/*][*][p]Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.
[/p][/*][*][p]If you’re playing on Steam, you’ll need to link your Steam account with your Gameforge account in order to manage your active characters. \[Click here] ([url="https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/348-from-steam-to-gameforge-how-to-link-accounts/"]https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/348-from-steam-to-gameforge-how-to-link-accounts/[/url]) to find out how it works.
[/p][/*][/list][h3] What if two or more characters have the same name?[/h3][list][*][p]Destination server characters can keep their names. Characters transferred to this server may need to be renamed.
[/p][/*][*][p]If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Can I change the name of my character on the Summer Oasis server?[/h3][p]
Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to your account being restricted.

[/p][h3]What will be transferred and what won’t be?[/h3][p]
[b][u]Transfer includes:[/u][/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window), plus regular inventories and equipment inventories
[/p][/*][*][p]Raid and mount inventories
[/p][/*][*][p]Costumes, specialist card inventories and active NosMall items (e.g. Inventory Expansions,
[/p][/*][/list][p]NosMerchant Medals).
[/p][list][*][p]Your Miniland, including NosMates and decorations (including Partner’s Backpack). [/p][/*][*][p]Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc.
[/p][/*][*][p]Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.
[/p][/*][*][p]Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your transferred character.
[/p][/*][*][p]All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the character transfer and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.
[/p][/*][*][p]As is standard, the destination servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 2,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the transfer, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Transfer excludes:[/u][/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Families will not be transferred. The contents of family warehouses will be sent per parcel to the family heads.
[/p][/*][*][p]Inactive auctions must be collected before the server closes, otherwise the items will be deleted. If you’ve lost an item for this reason, please contact our [url="https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de"]support team[/url].
[/p][/*][*][p]Friends list, blacklist and marriages will be deleted or dissolved.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3][p]
No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[/p][h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3][p]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[/p][h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3][p]
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials.

[/p][h3]What happens to quest items I can’t receive again?[/h3][p]
Items that you require for quests or similar which are lost during the character transfer, and which cannot be re-acquired via the game mechanics or the NosMall, can be restored to you by our [url="https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de"]Support team[/url]. Please get in touch if that’s the case.[/p]

titre: Community Update – H2 2026
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello again NosPlayers,

We’re back with another Community Update! Before we dive into what is still to come, we want to take a moment to celebrate what just launched: [b]Act 10 Part 2[/b] is now live! 

We hope you are enjoying the brand-new specialist cards, the new raid boss, and the quality-of-life improvements that came with it. If you haven’t dived in yet, now’s the time! 

Now, let’s take a look at what is still ahead for the second half of 2026. As always, timeframes may shift slightly, but we want to keep you in the loop!

[h2]What’s Coming in H2 2026[/h2]

[h3]Summer – Special Event Server & SP Balancing Adjustments[/h3]
This summer, we are launching another [b]event server with special settings[/b] and activities to keep you busy through August and September! Expect boosted progression, special achievements, and other surprises! It’s the perfect excuse to dive back in or try something fresh with your friends.

Alongside this, we are bringing [b]SP balancing adjustments to a range of specialist cards[/b], including older ones that have been waiting for some love. Our goal is to make more SPs feel rewarding and fun to play, giving you more viable options to explore!

[h3]19th Anniversary & The Celestial Spire Catacombs[/h3]
It is always incredible to look back at how far we’ve all come together. Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey! 

To celebrate our 19th anniversary, the classic birthday event is of course making its return, along with contests, great rewards, and merchandise.

But the big content focus of this patch is the Celestial Spire Catacombs, specifically an [b]extension to the catacombs[/b] that we are really excited about! Here’s what to expect:
[list][*]10 brand-new levels, pushing the spire all the way to level 30[/*][*]New challenging family missions to tackle together[/*][*]An updated token shop with new content to unlock[/*][*]Rebalancing of the existing levels, making the current experience smoother and fairerMore details will follow closer to release. Stay tuned![/*][/list]
[h3]Something Special Is Coming this Winter...[/h3]
We’re not ready to spill all the details just yet, but we can promise you that this winter season [b]we have something new planned[/b] that will definitely keep you busy over the holiday period. Keep an eye on our channels for more news! 

[h3]Quality of Life: We’re on a Roll![/h3]
You may have already noticed that we have been sneaking in [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] pretty much whenever we can this year. We kicked things off earlier in 2026 with a dedicated QoL update, kept the momentum going with more changes in Act 10 Part 2, and honestly? We’re really enjoying it!

Our goal is to keep introducing QoL improvements with every update for the rest of the year. NosTale should feel better and better to play as the months go on, and we are really motivated to make that happen. Some changes are more difficult than others to bring to life, but we will continue in that direction. So keep the feedback coming!

[h3]Seasonal Events[/h3]
Of course, your favourite traditions are staying right where they belong. Expect all the usual celebrations throughout the second half of the year, including Halloween and the winter and New Year festivities.

[h3]More to Come![/h3]
That’s all for our Community Update for now, but you know the drill.

As soon as we get closer to release, there will be the usual news updates and posts on our platforms, informing you in more detail about what is to come.

Until then, we ask for your patience and thank you for reading this update!

The NosTale Team

titre: Fan Art Contest: Seasonal Artworks Wanted!
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/9a96a4f0bcc43738c470b6c33beee13a74bdbf8b.jpg[/img]

NosFriends, we’re on the hunt for talented artists to create backgrounds for the character selection screen, inspired by any of the four seasons. Whether you choose spring, summer, autumn or winter, we want to see your creativity brought to life!

Grab your pencils, paintbrushes or tablets, and send us your themed images for the four seasons. Please remember that there must be space for the characters in the middle of the image (see below for more details).

[h3]Competition Details[/h3]
[list][*]Create a [b]seasonally themed[/b] image for the [b]character selection screen[/b].[/*][*]Dimensions: 1920x1400 (the image may be slightly stretched depending on game resolution)[/*][*]Format: [b]only .jpg[/b][/*][*]Using AI tools is not allowed and will lead to disqualification[/*][*]Send your creations directly as an email attachment (no external links) with the subject line [b]Seasonal Fan Art 2026[/b] to: event@nostale.co.uk[/*][*]Don’t forget to supply your [b]character and server name[/b].[/*][*]Deadline for submissions: [b]02/08/2026[/b][/*][*]When participating, the [url=https://agbserver.gameforge.com/files/pdf/en_GB/terms_raffles_and_competitions_en.pdf]Terms and Conditions for Participation[/url] and our [url=https://agbserver.gameforge.com/files/pdf/en_GB/general_terms_of_use_en.pdf]General Terms of Use[/url] apply.[/*][/list]
[b]Please note[/b] that there must be space for the characters in the centre of the image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2aa88c460156e87112a0b7637fd93b375e0595e9.png[/img]

[h3]Evidence of Authorship[/h3]
In order that we can verify the authenticity of the images, each submission must include images of the various stages of the creative process.

Examples of this could include:
[list][*]Initial sketches[/*][*]Line drawings[/*][*]Intermediate stages[/*][*]Colouring process[/*][*]Other pictures showing the work in progress[/*][/list]
Submissions which do not provide enough evidence of the creative process may be disqualified.

[h3]Submission Limits[/h3]
Each participant may only submit 1 artwork. The artwork must be designed specifically for the character selection screen, and should recognisably fit the theme of the seasons.

Multiple submissions from the same participant will not be accepted.

[h3]Originality[/h3]
All submitted artworks must be your own original creations. The use of AI-generated, AI-supported or plagiarised artworks is strictly prohibited.

Participants whose submissions are determined to be AI-generated or not be original content will be disqualified from the contest, as well as from future NosTale contests of any kind.

[b]Note[/b]: We invite you to sign your artworks so others can honour your contributions!

[h3]Prizes[/h3]
The top 10 artists each receive:
[list][*]An acrylic figurine and a keychain of either a female Fog Hunter or a male Fire Storm (of their choice)[/*][*]A Gameforge coupon worth €25.00[/*][*]The in-game title ‘Artiste’[/*][/list]
We look forward to seeing your ideas!
The NosTale Team

titre: Act 10 Part 2 & SP12 – Patch Notes
texte:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A new set of specialist cards (SP12) has been added to the game, with one card per class. The quest can be started with Commander Ellyk in Dimension Rift 1.[/p][list][*][p] The specialist card Achilles has been added for Swordsmen. This specialist uses the crossbow to attack. This decision was made to provide more variety and spice for Swordsmen. Since this class already has the Berserker and Death Reaper specialists, and otherwise only the Crusader uses the secondary weapon, introducing another specialist which uses the secondary weapon allows for more character customisation. It will also give the gameplay more longevity. This specialist is kitted out with lots of debuffs, and designed to maximise range, while dealing the greatest amount of damage in various areas of the game. 	[/p][/*][*][p]Archers get the Admiral Yi specialist card. This specialist uses the dagger to attack. Again, this decision was made to introduce more variety. The Archer already has the Scout and Ranger specialists which are excellent single-target damage dealers in PvP. This specialist is instead designed to be capable of dealing with hordes of monsters in quick fashion. They can inflict large amounts of damage to enemies in all areas of the game in short order with rapid attacks. [/p][/*][*][p]The specialist card Merlin has been added for Mages. Once more, this specialist uses their secondary weapon, the spell gun. Following SP11, we learned how having a hybrid specialist who uses both primary and secondary weapons can be problematic, hence why this specialist will only use the secondary weapon. This specialist serves as a hybrid damage/support class, with a variety of buffs and debuffs at its disposal.  [b]	[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The Thor specialist card has been added for Martial Artists. As per the others, this specialist also uses its secondary weapon to attack. After the successful introduction of the Thunderer, we made the decision that this water specialist would attack with its secondary weapon, as the Martial Artist already has the Mystic Arts specialist card. This specialist bolsters raid teams with buffs and debuffs, while also being able to deal out lashings of damage.  [/p][p][/p][p]You can find the skills and buffs of the new Specialists here [url="https://nostale.comastuff.com/Guides/guides.php?id=69"]https://nostale.comastuff.com/Guides/guides.php?id=69[/url]

[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gleaming Melon Stones cannot be used for these specialists at the start.[/p][/*][*][p]As with previous SP series, there will be a buff for the SP12 series upon release.[/p][/*][*][p]A new raid becomes available at the same time: [/p][list][*][p]The raid can be entered from champion level 90 	[/p][/*][*][p]The raid can be started on the map Nezarun’s Fortress 	[/p][/*][*][p]Up to 16 players can enter the raid 	[/p][/*][*][p]Entering requires that the Act 10.2 side quest which has the raid as its goal has been completed[/p][/*][*][p]The raid has no lobby map, but consists of 2 phases each with its own mechanics and bosses[/p][/*][*][p]The raid can be completed up to 5 times per day, and the raid box reward is not tradeable[/p][/*][*][p] Completing the raid rewards a perfection stone for the new specialists in addition to the raid box[/p][/*][*][p] The raid seal can be obtained from Shadows in the Dimension Rifts [/p][/*][*][p]Increased chance of rarity-level 7 and 8 raid boxes with bette[b] [/b]contents[/p][/*][*][p]A new family mission has been added[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b]: [/p][list][*][p]Raid bosses can now be targeted via their health bars[/p][/*][*][p]Various items such as Mother Nature’s runes, Pet Pearls and Golden Specialist Card Holders are now available in stackable versions[/p][/*][*][p]The following items can be opened using the bulk opening feature for raid boxes: [/p][list][*][p]Tarot Card Games, Sealed Treasure Chests, Mother Nature’s Rune Packs, Shining Soul Random Boxes, Completion Gemstone Boxes, Small Completion Gemstone Boxes, Squiff-Eels, Ruby of Completion Bags and Sapphire of Completion Bags [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following changes have been made to chat restrictions: [/p][list][*][p]Restrictions now also apply to pet and partner chats  	[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocking all chat features re[b]uires either level 65+ or reaching the reputation NosBlu[/b]	[/p][/*][*][p]Until this requirement has been fu[b]filled, shops will now be labelled as ‘Playername’s Shop[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The ‘Reduced to carrying out normal attacks by sheer anger.’ effect no longer applies to monsters[/p][/*][*][p]The ‘Provides an X% chance to reset the cooldown of the attack skill used’ effect is now capped at 80%
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Bugfix] The damage of the Onyx Dragon now counts as player damage towards the minimum damage required in hardcore raids or for calculating EXP[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  Players are no longer teleported if they use a Dash skill while changing maps[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  Damage effects from runes and other sources no longer prevent your skill bar from being updated[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  Fixed various issues which caused game crashes[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  The ‘No penalty for ranged attacks at close range’ effect on the Attack Amp buff now works as intended[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  Fixed an issue where certain skills could not be used after increasing job level[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  Token bar text is now removed after logging back in[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix]  Token bar text is now repositioned after changing resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bugfix] Fixed an issue with the effect "Blocks x bad effects up to level y"[/p][/*][/list]

titre: Meet & Greet at gamescom 2026
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/5efa7b7cdbb78e1308868742203cc043c801fdf5.jpg[/img]

Are you attending [b]gamescom[/b] this year? Then don't miss the opportunity to meet us in person!

On [b]Saturday, 29th August[/b], come and say hello to [b]CM Daveius (EN/ES)[/b] and [b]CM Zenitsusan (EN/DE)[/b]! Whether you'd like to chat about NosTale, ask questions, share your feedback, or simply meet the team behind the game, we'd be delighted to see you there.

[h2]Register in Advance[/h2]

titre: Act 10.2 – Guardians of Dimensions & Summer Event
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/f1c966c47fcb98df560874499b92d68756fd1662.jpg[/img]

New powers arise from the depths of the dimensions. On [b]15th July 2026[/b], a new chapter begins in the world of NosTale with [b]Act 10.2 – Guardians of Dimensions[/b]. Confront distorted realities, ancient heroic powers, and a threat born of the very heart of the dimensions itself.

Meet new specialists, explore engaging class raids, and take on a new raid! Plus the summer event with the feared Captain Pete O’Peng returns!

[h2]Act 10.2 – Guardians of Dimensions[/h2]
[h3]New Specialists: Guardians of Dimensions[/h3]
Each class receives a new specialist to face the fresh threats from the dimensions. These specialists can be unlocked via a special quest line.

[b]Guardian of Dimensions for Swordsmen: Achilles[/b]
A dark spearman who channels the power of the River Styx and attacks from range with deadly projectiles.

[b]Guardian of Dimensions for Archers: Admiral Yi[/b]
A legendary strategist who embodies the power of a historic hero, and wields his katana with deadly precision.

[b]Guardian of Dimensions for Mages: Merlin[/b]
A bard of light, blessed by the Guardian of the Lake, who fights with divine energy.

[b]Guardian of Dimensions for Martial Artists: Thor[/b]
A water and lightning specialist who combines the powers of thunder, frost and electricity.

[h3]New Class Quests[/h3]
Fifty new quests have been added for each class. Over the course of the quest line, players travel to different historical and mythical dimensions:
[list][*]Swordsmen: Ancient Greece[/*][*]Archers: Joseon Dynasty[/*][*]Mages: Britain[/*][*]Martial Artists: Thrudheim[/*][/list]
Legendary heroes will support you in these locations during decisive moments of their history.

The quest line starts with Commander Ellyk in the Time-Space rift and requires at least champion level 90.

[h3]New Raid: Battle-Ready Dr Dimensio Raid[/h3]
Take on the new 15-player raid and battle against the Battle-Ready Dr Dimensio to earn materials for the new specialists.
[list][*]Boss: Battle-Ready Dr Dimensio Raid[/*][*]Location: Portal in Dimension Rift 4[/*][*]Requirement: Champion Level 90+[/*][/list]
[h3]Dimensional Synchronisation[/h3]
All new specialists use Dimensional Synchronisation:
[list][*]A sync gauge is filled during combat.[/*][*]When it reaches 100%, you get a Sync Buff (3 levels).[/*][*]The buff level increases each time the gauge is filled.[/*][*]The gauge stops charging when you reach the maximum level, until the buff ends.[/*][*]Special effect: Hero Echoes may appear when attacking to deal additional damage.[/*][*]Each specialist has their own Hero Echo and damage scaling. The effects, damage stats and strengths of the Hero Echoes depend on the buff level and class.[/*][/list]
[h2]Summer Event with Captain Pete O’Peng[/h2]
It’s time for this year’s summer event! Look out for the return of the fearsome pirate [b]Captain Pete O’Peng[/b]. Confront him and win great rewards!

[b]Event period[/b]: 15th July (11 AM) to 19th August (11 AM CEST)
[list][*]Eliminate the wicked Captain Pete O’Peng and his crew in the Pirate Raid for 10 to 15 players! Pillage the raid box and snap up the [b]Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona, the ‘Arrrrr!’ title or one of the four Pirate Bushtails[/b] amongst many other items.[/*][*]Slip on the elegant [b]Navy Costume[/b]! The Captain’s Hat provides a 2% chance of inflicting Strong Freeze on your opponent. The costume provides a 5% chance of reducing all attack damage by 80%. Both items of clothing increase your water resistance by 2%.[/*][*]The [b]Arrrrr![/b] title increases your HP by +300 and will show Captain Pete O’Peng who the real pirate is around here![/*][/list]
Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: Event: Lord Melonoth’s Summer Raid
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d9ae25b0d1d7bb8825553fd9f1e7141f015c7383.jpg[/img]

Get ready for a fruitastic challenge this summer! Battle against fruity monsters like Bananosaurus and Dragon Fruitlets, then defeat Lord Melonoth himself in the summer raid!

Rewards such as little fruit pets, an additional mini pet, the Fruity Ninja title and much more await!

[b]Running[/b]: 10th June (11 AM) to 15th July (11 AM CEST)

[h3]The Story So Far[/h3]

Some time ago, the Mullans of Undercity started to trade with people from the surface. These new dealings gave the Mullans their first taste of fresh fruit! One tribe member, by the name of Doctor Frox, was munching down on some of this fruit from the surface, and became absolutely obsessed with the taste.

He focused all of his energies on cultivating varieties of fruit plants which would be capable of surviving in the darkness of Undercity. He set up [i]Frox’s Fruit Lab[/i] as a research institute and started a number of botanical experiments. Using a specially developed serum, Doctor Frox wanted to promote growth in his plants.
The first results were fruitful, and his plants flourished despite the total darkness. But something went wrong... the serum had some unexpected side effects. The plants mutated, outgrowing their natural size and becoming intelligent – and hostile!
The fruit monsters broke out of the laboratory and made their way to the surface, where they started to attack the nearby settlements.

Riddled with guilt, Doctor Frox has followed them to the surface, and is now searching for help. He needs someone who is courageous and strong enough to stop these unbridled creatures, before they can plunge the surface into chaos.

[h3]Raid Info[/h3]

In order to participate in the Lord Melonoth Raid, you must first complete the Time-Space quest Lab on Alert. Only the raid leader needs the Raid Seal of Lord Melonoth to start the raid.

You also receive the Fresh Melon Rind (Event) in reward which allows you to deal double damage to the mini-bosses and the raid boss.

The Time-Space quest can be completed up to 5 times per day. The raid can be entered via Bunny’s Backyard in NosVille.

A maximum of 15 players can participate in a raid. Players must face a platter of fruity enemies to defeat, followed by Lord Melonoth himself, before they can get the amazing rewards from his raid box.

[b]Raid Box of Lord Melonoth[/b]
The box can contain these items:
[list]
[*]10x Angel’s Feather

[*]3x Completion Gemstone Box
[*]1x Special Fruit (Event)
[*]5x/3x Shiny Sky Blue Gemstone
[/list]
You can also loot various items from the fruity monsters during the event which can be exchanged for the following rewards from Doctor Frox:
[list]
[*]1x Minilonopus
[*]1x Mini Bananosaurus
[*]1x Mini Dapplodocus
[*]1x Mini Pitadraya

titre: End of the NosFire Server & Server Merge
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/565fd6a5da18aed93a3b7b6130b813bcd0b43585.jpg[/img]

The embers are burning out and our fiery event server is coming to a close. As announced when we launched the NosFire server, there will be a NosFire server merge on [b]Wednesday, 10th June 2026[/b]. If you haven’t done so already, remember to select your destination server for the character transfer this week!

Enjoy the final days of NosFire and have fun playing!

The NosTale Team

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How do I choose a server?[/h3]
The Battle Pass gives you access to a box with multiple items that allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item represents a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you only have until the NosFire server closes to choose your destination server.

[h3]Are there any rules for transferring characters?[/h3]
You must select a destination server for your character transfer before the NosFire server closes on Wednesday 10th June 2026, after which point you will no longer be able to make a transfer.

If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to rename your character the first time you log in after the server merge.

If all the character slots on your chosen server are taken, your character will be deactivated. On the website, you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish:
[list][*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.[/*][*]Click on Settings to open your account settings.[/*][*]This takes you to the corresponding NosTale web page where you can view your character list.[/*][*]If you’ve got more than four characters, you can swap an active character for a deactivated one.[/*][/list]
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.

If you’re playing on Steam, you’ll need to link your Steam account with your Gameforge account in order to manage your active characters. [url=https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/348-from-steam-to-gameforge-how-to-link-accounts/]Click here[/url] to find out how it works.

[h3]What will be transferred and what won’t be?[/h3]
[b]Transfer includes:[/b]
[list][*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window).[/*][*]With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items.[/*][*]Costumes, specialist card inventories and active NosMall items (e.g. Inventory Expansions,NosMerchant Medals).[/*][*]Your Miniland, including NosMates and decorations (excluding Partner’s Backpack).[/*][*]Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc.[/*][*]Any NosMall items purchased via the website that you do not collect can be collected on the destination server.[/*][/list]
[b]Transfer excludes:[/b]
[list][*]Families will not be transferred and the contents of family warehouses will be deleted.[/*][*]Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).[/*][*]NosBazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.[/*][*]Raid and mount inventories will not be transferred.[/*][*]Friends list, blacklist and marriages will be deleted or dissolved.[/*][*]All parcels (post) will be deleted during the merge.[/*][*]Please note: Any rewards you get from the Battle Pass or the Progress Book will not be transferred. Make sure you collect these beforehand.[/*][/list]
[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]
No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials.

[h3]What happens to quest items that I can't obtain again?[/h3]
Items required for quests or systems that are lost during the merge and cannot be obtained again through in-game mechanics or the NosMall, can be restored by contacting our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]support team[/url].

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

[b]About the Land of Life[/b]
The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance [b]earn 100% more experience[/b].

The Land of Life is divided into three zones: one for champion level 30–64, one for 60–82 and one for 80–90. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:

titre: NosFire 2026: Patch Notes
texte:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg"][/img]

Hello,

It’s the moment many of you have been waiting for—now it’s finally here: NosFire 2026!
You can look forward to old favourites and fresh content all at once.

[h2]NosFire-Specific Changes:[/h2][list]  [*]A new battle pass featuring seasonal and a few weekly missions is launching    [list]      [*]Some battle pass missions will now reward you with items directly, so as not to make the requirements for server transfer items any more difficult, whilst there are also more missions available to help you progress faster.[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]The Progress Book is back, containing missions and rewards to help you develop your character. You can find this in the same book as the Pet Trainer in the character info.[/*]  [*]You can choose between 4 different classes (Swordsman, Archer, Mage and Martial Artist) starting at level 80 and job level 80.[/*]  [*]After choosing your character, you’ll receive fairies, resistances, level-80 starting gear, champion level 10 gear, champion level 25/28 gear (soulbound and upgraded to +7 with rarity level 5 and fixed shells), plus specialist cards 1 and 2 with job level 50 upgraded to +5 (with additional SP points). Martial Artists also receive the first two specialist cards right from the start.[/*]  [*]Active and passive skills are automatically learned after you create your character.[/*]  [*]Your quest progress starts in Act 4, and all Time-Spaces below level 80 will be marked as completed.[/*]  [*]Minigames, Instant Combat and Rainbow Battles will be available from level 85.[/*]  [*]Gold and reputation from the Martial Artist’s specialist card 1 and 2 quests will be removed.[/*]  [*]The gold for Act 5.1 quests is reduced.[/*]  [*]Time-Spaces 1–80 are increased to level 84 (excluding Time-Spaces for levels 25, 32 and 49).[/*]  [*]Time-Spaces 25, 32 and 49 require 99 Seeds of Power to enter.[/*]  [*]The Glacerus, Lord Draco, Laurena, Fafnir and Yertirand raids require at least level 85 to enter.[/*]  [*]The second lobby maps in the Valehir, Alzanor, Asgobas, Pollutus and Giant Arma raids have been removed.[/*]  [*]The warehouse has been removed from all NPCs and crafting recipes.[/*]  [*]The most popular maps from Acts 6, 7, 8 and 9 have been copied multiple times with map channels.[/*]  [*]The requirements in Act 4 elimination quests have been reduced.[/*]  [*]The equipment from the Ibrahim raid can now be produced for Robber Band Gold Coins by a new NPC in the Desert Eagle City.[/*]  [*]Lord Mukraju is available in a weaker form.[/*]  [*]Server tickets can no longer be deleted.[/*]  [*]Act 5.2 raid rewards can be received from level 81.[/*]  [*]Martial Artists can start the 3rd specialist quest directly without having to have previously completed specialists 1 and 2.[/*]  [*]Soulstones are available as rewards for completing Act 6.1 and Act 7.1.[/*]  [*]Restrictions on chat, speakers and minigames have been adjusted to level 83 in line with the NosFire starting conditions.[/*]  [*]Entry level restrictions on group time spaces have also been adjusted and increased to level 85.[/*]  [*]Ice Flowers can only be picked from level 85 upwards.[/*]  [*]The South Beach Time-Space now no longer gives gold as a reward.[/*]  [*]Reputation from the Cuby raid has been removed as a reward.[/*]  [*]Reputation has been removed as a reward from PL1 Time-Spaces.[/*]  [*]Gold has been removed as a reward from the PL1 and Fisherman Time-Spaces.[/*]  [*]Legend and above reputation ranks will now require having at least 5 000 000 reputation.[/*]  [*]Chicken King raid will be enabled, and the raid seals will be obtainable from a Time-Space placed in front of the raid entry map.[/*]  [*]The number of some of the monsters related to Act 4 quests has been increased.[/*]  [*]Changes to Minigame Requirements:[/*][/list][table]      [tr]      [th]Minigame Level[/th]      [th]Current Level[/th]      [th]New Level[/th]      [th]Current Reputation[/th]      [th]New Reputation[/th]    [/tr]        [tr]      [td]1[/td]      [td]30[/td]      [td]81[/td]      [td]5001[/td]      [td]85001[/td]    [/tr]    [tr]      [td]2[/td]      [td]40[/td]      [td]82[/td]      [td]25001[/td]      [td]190001[/td]    [/tr]    [tr]      [td]3[/td]      [td]50[/td]      [td]83[/td]      [td]85001[/td]      [td]350001[/td]    [/tr] titre: Hot News: NosFire Returns!
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/565fd6a5da18aed93a3b7b6130b813bcd0b43585.jpg[/img]

The legendary NosFire event server is back! Get ready for some searing hot NosFire action, level up at turbo speed, and take advantage of various events, boosts, and other benefits!
[list][*][b]NosFire Event Server Starts[/b]: 1st April 2026[/*][*][b]NosFire Event Server Ends[/b]: 10th June 2026[/*][/list]
[h3]Permanent Boosts[/h3]
The following boosts are permanently active on the event server:
[list][*]2x EXP[/*][*]4x Reputation[/*][*]2x EXP for fishing, cooking, and training pets[/*][*]2x Fairy XP[/*][*]2x Gold[/*][*]2x Drops[/*][*]3x Family XP[/*][/list]
[h3]NosFire Event Server FAQ[/h3]
Find out everything you need to know about the [b]NosFire event server[/b] here!

[b]How long will NosFire be online before I can transfer registered characters?[/b]
[list][*]NosFire will be online for 10 weeks, from 1st April until 10th June 2026.[/*][/list]
[b]What’s special about NosFire?[/b]
[list][*]All characters start at level 80/job level 80, with quest progress starting in Act 4.[/*][*]Various character-bound items will also be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 50+5.[/*][*]Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.[/*][*]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosFire event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.[/*][*]Certain content, such as Act 8 raids, will be simplified, and the entry level for certain raids will be adjusted.[/*][*]The Arena of Talents will be disabled on NosFire.[/*][*]You cannot craft or purchase warehouses from NPCs.[/*][*]The entry level for certain Time-Spaces will be adjusted.[/*][*]You cannot earn gold from the SP 1+2 Martial Artist quest.[/*][*]The entry level for Instant Combats and Rainbow Battles has been changed to level 85.[/*][*]You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.[/*][/list]
[b]How do I transfer my character?[/b]
[list][*]Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred.[/*][/list]
[b]How do I choose a server?[/b]
[list][*]There will be different items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item represents a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosFire event server closes to choose your destination server.[/*][/list]
[b]Where do I see which server I’ve selected?[/b]
[list][*]You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).[/*][/list]
[b]Can I transfer my items with my character?[/b]
[list][*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals, as well as the Miniland (NosMates and decorations), will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.[/*][/list]
[b]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, there will be a free Battle Pass for the NosFire server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.[/*][*]The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, transfer items, and the item transfer warehouse.[/*][/list]
[b]Are there any rules for transferring?[/b]
Certainly! The following rules apply:
[list][*]You must select a server to transfer your character to before the NosFire event server is closed on 10th June 2026, otherwise you won’t be able to transfer your character. We will PM your character multiple times, reminding you to transfer your character before it is no longer possible to.[/*][*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.[/*][*]Families and family warehouses will not be transferred.[/*][*]Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).[/*][*]NosBazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.[/*][*]The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) apart from the Partner’s Backpack.[/*][*]Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc., will also be transferred.[/*][*]If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the first time you log in after transferring.[/*][*]If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated. You can reactivate them in the standard manner via the website.[/*][*]Uncollected NosMall items can be collected on the destination server.[/*][*]Your friends list, blacklist, and marriage will not be transferred.[/*][/list]
[b]Which boosts will be available and when?[/b]
[list][*]The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosFire server:[/*][*]2x EXP[/*][*]4x Reputation[/*][*]2x EXP for fishing, cooking, and training pets[/*][*]2x Fairy XP[/*][*]2x Gold[/*][*]2x Drops[/*][*]3x Family XP[/*][*]In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.[/*][/list]
[b]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the NosFire server, albeit with lower boosts.[/*][/list]
[b]Will there be an Easter event on every server?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, the Easter event will be active on every server (starting 1st April 2026).[/*][/list]
[b]Will there be special server first challenges?[/b]
[list][*]No, there are no server first challenges planned for this event server.[/*][/list]
[b]Can I change the name of my character on the NosFire event server?[/b]
[list][*]Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to your account being restricted.[/*][/list]
[b]Info & Patch notes[/b]
More information and detailed patch notes will be published shortly.

titre: Raid QoL Update – Patch Notes
texte:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello,

We know how important quality-of-life improvements are for your gaming experience. While we always try to squeeze in a few little enhancements of this type with each larger patch, in this update we wanted to place the focus on the thing that makes NosTale so amazing – on you, the players.
Raids are the most common activity in the game, yet we know how tedious some things can be. That’s why we wanted to introduce some meaningful improvements with this update, concentrating on quality-of-life features for raids.

Look forward to the following QoL improvements in the update:[/p][list][*][p]Added a 63-slot raid inventory, which can be found in the top-right of the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 20-slot mount inventory, which can be found under the additional inventories.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option which allows you to automatically open up to 999 raid boxes in succession. Double-click on a raid box and then decide how many you want to open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to quickly invite raid members from the previous raid team.[/p][list][*][p]This option is only available to the raid team leader.[/p][/*][*][p]Only works if the team size is the same or smaller than the previous raid.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added two new settings:[/p][list][*][p]You now have the option to toggle the damage, healing and bleeding effects inflicted by other players.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now toggle various visual effects from other players including:[/p][list][*][p]SP wings[/p][/*][*][p]+16–20 SP upgrade effects[/p][/*][*][p]Mount visual effects[/p][/*][*][p]Rune animations[/p][/*][*][p]Partner S-skill glow effects[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Smileys[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
But these aren’t the only changes we’re introducing, we will also have a further round of SP balancing changes. Specialist cards are one of the major features which make NosTale so unique and enjoyable. Over the past 18 years, many new specialist cards have been introduced, and some of the older ones have gotten a little long in the tooth and suffered over the passage of time. This includes the 5th generation of specialist cards, which will be the main focus of these SP balancing changes, but a few other specialists which have been somewhat overpowered in recent years will also be tweaked to produce a more level playing field.

The following specialists will be updated:[/p][list][*][p]Fire Cannoneer[/p][/*][*][p]Gladiator[/p][/*][*][p]Volcano[/p][/*][*][p]Scout[/p][/*][*][p]Seer[/p][/*][*][p]Dark Gunner[/p][/*][*][p]Hydraulic Fist[/p][/*][/list][p]All changes can be found here: [url="https://nostale.comastuff.com/SP_Balacing_Raid_QoL_Patchnotes.pdf"]https://nostale.comastuff.com/SP_Balacing_Raid_QoL_Patchnotes.pdf[/url][/p][p]Another issue we want to address is inflation, which has been particularly exacerbated in recent months. We’ve seen your suggestions and feedback on this issue, but it is not something that can be solved in one fell swoop. Remediating this issue will be a longer process that takes place bit by bit, and we’ll take the first step with this update by reducing the gold which can be found in Zenas and Erenia’s raids. Our data shows that these raids have generated the most gold over recent months. While this may seem like a drastic decision, we believe is the right act to take in order to maintain a healthy economy in the future.

Here’s the full list of changes:[/p][list][*][p]Map instances will be added to the most important level maps in Acts 6–9 and all maps in Act 10.[/p][list][*][p]These will replace the map copies.[/p][/*][*][p]11 map instances will be available for the selected maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Instances can be changed from the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]When changing to another instance, you receive a penalty making it impossible to earn experience for 120 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]This excludes Amulets of Return and the Miniland.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The HP and respawn times for monsters in Act 10 have been changed: [url="https://nostale.comastuff.com/Raid_QoL_Misc_Patchnotes.pdf"]https://nostale.comastuff.com/Raid_QoL_Misc_Patchnotes.pdf[/url][/p][/*][*][p]The channel-wide message when a raid has been successfully completed has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]When switching maps, the camera is now zoomed out to the maximum.[/p][/*][*][p]From Act 6.2 onwards, NPCs can now be found in front of the raid instances who provide the relevant daily quests.[/p][/*][*][p]The gold drops in the Erenia and Zenas raids has been reduced from 25,000 Gold to 5,000 Gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Various NPCs like Graham, Dr Dimensio etc. have received shop names to make it easier to click on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Anti-bot measures have been introduced:[/p][list][*][p]The general chat can only be used from level 65.[/p][/*][*][p]Items like Speakers and Speech Bubbles can only be used from level 65.[/p][list][*][p]Speakers have a cooldown of 1 minute.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sending a Note now has a cooldown of 10 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Whispering now has the following restrictions:[/p][list][*][p]Whispering to different players now has a 5-minute cooldown below level 65.[/p][/*][*][p]Whispering to the same player has no restrictions below level 65.[/p][/*][*][p]There are no restrictions from level 65.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Full Moon Crystals from minigames are now limited.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following changes have been made to hardcore raids:[/p][list][*][p]You can now receive limited Full Moon Crystals when successfully completing a hardcore raid.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now receive fairy experience for successfully completing a hardcore raid.[/p][/*][*][p]Hardcore raids now have a weekly limit instead of a daily one.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new items have been added to the token shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Various changes have been made to the token shops: [url="https://nostale.comastuff.com/Raid_QoL_Misc_Patchnotes.pdf"]https://nostale.comastuff.com/Raid_QoL_Misc_Patchnotes.pdf[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gold has been removed from the Glacernon, fairy and party Time-Spaces.[/p][/*][*][p]The minimum level for party Time-Spaces is now level 70.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]The ‘Hat is invisible’ option no longer hides costume wings.[/p][/*][*][p]The ‘Toggle smileys’ option is now available in the visual effect options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the new passive equipment buffs from Act 10 were removed when entering the Rainbow Battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Sunchaser’s wolf didn’t receive damage reduction like NosMates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Nezarun raid where certain mechanics could be triggered simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list]

titre: Events: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b15ef62a7db6e27bf962710319cc8068b56026de.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]13/03 (11 AM) and 16/03 (11 AM CET)[/b], you have a [b]50% improved chance[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team
