titre: Update: Raid Improvements, Contest & More
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b6324a3b1cb3c7678ed938e47558a62514b17563.jpg[/img]

Here’s some news to get all those brave adventurers’ hearts beating. Starting [b]16th March 2026[/b], all you raid fans can look forward to a huge raft of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b]!

Plus there are great prizes waiting to be won in our [b]ShorTale Contest[/b].

Read on to learn what to look forward to:

[h2]Improvements for Raid Adventurers[/h2]

We’ve made lots of tweaks and improvements to ensure you can fully concentrate on those epic battles and legendary loot. Get ready for the following changes:

[h3]Better Unboxing[/h3]

Until now, you had to open each raid box individually, which could be particularly irksome when you had a lot. Not any more!

Now you’ll be able to choose how many boxes you want to open at once, assuming you have multiple. These will be opened automatically, one after another, so you can collect your hard-fought rewards much more easily.

More time for action, less clicking around!

[h3]Reinvite Your Team[/h3]

Together you are unstoppable! But until now, you always had to assemble your team manually after every raid.

With the latest update, the game will remember your last teammates, until you close the client. When you start a new raid, your previous team will be suggested to you, and you can invite them all again with a single click.

That way you can put the band back together in a flash, and plunge straight into your next adventure!

[h3]Stackable Raid Boxes (Rarity Levels 7/8)[/h3]

It’s a familiar problem: your inventory and NosBazaar get filled to the brim with lots of rarity level 7/8 raid boxes in next to no time. Managing all that costs time... and your sanity! In the new update, those raid rewards are much easier to handle:
[list]
[*]All newly looted raid boxes following the update will be replaced by stackable versions.
[*]The drop chances and rewards remain unchanged.
[/list]So while nothing changes about the raid rewards themselves, your inventory will have an easier time of things!

[h3]New Raid Inventory[/h3]

Raid seals, tokens, boxes, these all used to take up valuable space in your regular inventory. With the new update, a dedicated raid inventory will be added to separate raid-related items from your regular inventory.

The raid inventory in detail:
[list]
[*]63 slots in total
[*]49 slots available as standard
[*]14 additional unlockable slots
[*]Only for Main items (no equipment)
[*]Accessible via a new interface button
[/list]
The following will be automatically stored there:
[list]
[*]Raid seals
[*]Raid tokens
[*]Raid boxes (including new rarity level 7/8 boxes)
[*]Certain general raid items
[/list]
If your raid inventory gets full, items will automatically be moved to your regular inventory.
Raid items thus finally get their own home!

[h3]Better Performance Options[/h3]

Graphical effects can have a big negative impact performance, particularly in raids. That’s why we’re introducing new settings allowing you to customise your display options.

The existing options to toggle smileys and HP status have been removed, and replaced with more flexible solutions.

[b]Option 1 – Damage & Healing[/b]
Toggle the damage and healing numbers from other players.

[b]Option 2 – Manage Visual Effects[/b]
You can toggle the following effects from other players:
[list]
[*]SP +16–20 effects
[*]Equipment glow effects (+1–13)
[*]Mount effects (e.g. smoke effects)
[*]Rune animations on weapons/armour
[*]Smileys
[*]Specialist partner skill glow effects
[*]Specialist card wings
[/list]
This way you have all the tools at your command to choose the graphics level or performance you need.

[h3]Mount Inventory[/h3]

A dedicated mount inventory has also been added. This can be used within the "additional" inventory, but cannot be added to quickslots.

[h2]ShorTale Contest[/h2]

NosTale’s raids have never been better – and we’re celebrating that with a short video contest!

Create a short with your funny, epic or creative raid moments. Whether you present your best meme, most epic finish, or most catastrophic fail, show us what you’ve experienced in NosTale’s raids and be in with a chance to win some great prizes!

More details on the contest will follow soon.

Happy raiding!
The NosTale Team

titre: Events: Lunar New Year & Valentine’s Day
texte:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d6373d173c44fd7edcaae21576e3fa672b342c62.jpg"][/img]
Two very special events are waiting for you in NosTale: help Mimi Mentor to recover the stolen goods during the [b]Lunar New Year[/b], and celebrate [b]Valentine’s Day[/b] with romantic quests, gestures of love and epic rewards!

[/p][h2]Lunar New Year: Mimi Needs Help[/h2][p]
From [b]11th February to 25th February[/b], thieving fiends are causing trouble in NosTale’s Lunar New Year festivities. They played a nasty trick on Mimi Mentor and stole some precious things from her. Help Mimi by finding her stolen items and earn yourself a New Year’s Gift Box.

[/p][h3]How it works:[/h3][list][*][p]Talk to Mimi Mentor.
[/p][/*][*][p]Travel around the world of NosTale and defeat monsters. With a bit of luck, one of these thieving monsters will appear (excluding Instant Combat, raids, Time-Spaces, Glacernon, Land of Death and Land of Life).
[/p][/*][*][p]The thieves won’t defend themselves and can be beaten with just five blows, but make sure those pesky good-for-nothings don’t slip through your fingers.
[/p][/*][*][p]After every blow, each of them will drop one of the following items:
[/p][/*][*][p]Gold
[/p][/*][*][p]Golden New Year’s Carrot
[/p][/*][*][p]Tasty Carrot Snack
[/p][/*][*][p]Stolen Gift Bag
[/p][/*][*][p]Stolen Lucky Charm
[/p][/*][*][p]Return the stolen goods back to Mimi and you’ll earn a New Year’s Gift Box.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]The New Year’s Gift Box may contain the following:[/h3][list][*][p]New Year Lucky Pig
[/p][/*][*][p]Bushtail Costume Scroll
[/p][/*][*][p]March Hare Costume (7 Days)
[/p][/*][*][p]March Hare Hat (7 Days)
[/p][/*][*][p]Adorable Bunny Costume (7 Days)
[/p][/*][*][p]Adorable Bunny Ears (7 Days)
[/p][/*][*][p]Golden New Year’s Carrot
[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh Carrot Juice
[/p][/*][*][p]Tasty Carrot Snack
[/p][/*][*][p]Cute Bunny
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Valentine’s Day in NosTale[/h2][p]
We’re sure there’s someone special in NosVille you’ve always wanted to confess your love to. Valentine’s Day is the perfect time to finally take the plunge. Romantic events and fantastic rewards await between [b]11th February and 25th February[/b]!

[/p][h3]Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows[/h3][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Help Amora spread the love in NosVille. To do that she’ll need some arrows.
[/p][/*][*][p]Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 70. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her! [/p][/*][*][p]You’ll get the Wedding Costume Specialist Card (one per character) as a thank you.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Event: Share the Love![/h3][list][*][p]Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.
[/p][/*][*][p]Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love!
[/p][/*][*][p]If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.
[/p][/*][*][p]1–3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing
[/p][/*][*][p]4–9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing
[/p][/*][*][p]10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing
[/p][/*][*][p]Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong!
[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/h3][p]
Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of Wingless Amora and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your ranged partner as a quest reward: Wingless Amora (one per character).

[/p][h3]Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices[/h3][p]
Let your long-awaited dreams of the big day come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount. Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more. This offer applies during the Valentine’s Event. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team[/p]

texte:

[list]

The Adorable Alien pet supports you with the following effects:
[list]

[/list]
The Sweet Honeybee supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 5%
[*]Increases experience earned by 5%
[*]Increases champion XP earned by 3%
[/list]
The Little Rainbow Spirit supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 5%

The duration of your mini pet starts only once you have equipped it for the first time. It is tradeable only until that point. The duration of the mini pet is measured in real time, meaning it continues to count down even when you are not logged in. When it expires, your mini pet will disappear.

titre: Community Update – H1 2026
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers,

A new chapter of NosTale is on the horizon, and we’re excited to give you a first glimpse of what awaits in the [b]first half of 2026[/b]. This is just a teaser – not the full reveal – but it should be more than enough to spark your curiosity and get you ready for what’s coming!

[h1]What’s Coming in H1 2026[/h1]
[h2]Quality-of-Life Update 1: Raid Improvements[/h2]
In 2026, our main goal is clear: make NosTale more enjoyable to play. We’ll be rolling out [b]several quality-of-life updates[/b] throughout the year, starting with a first convenience update fully focused on raids. Expect smoother raid preparation, smarter systems, and features designed to reduce friction and increase fun. From dedicated inventories to auto re-invite options, we’re polishing the raid experience so you can focus on what really matters: fighting together and earning great rewards. And this is just the beginning – more QoL improvements are planned for 2026, so stay tuned!

[h2]Act 10 Part 2 – The Birth of the Dimension Guardians[/h2]
The Dimensional Tales continue! Act 10 Part 2 will introduce [b]brand-new specialist cards[/b], each bringing exciting designs and new ways to play your favourite classes. But that’s not all: a [b]new raid boss[/b] will also arrive, ready to test even the most experienced adventurers. Team up with your friends, discover new mechanics, and chase powerful rewards as the story of NosTale’s dimensions expands further.

Specialist cards will also receive some well-deserved attention in 2026. Alongside Act 10 Part 2, we’re planning some [b]SP balance adjustments[/b] (timing to be confirmed). Our goal is to improve overall fairness and ensure more specialist cards feel satisfying, viable, and fun to use in real gameplay situations.

[h2]NosFire Server Returns[/h2]
The third edition of the [b]NosFire[/b] server is on the way! If you’re looking for a fresh start, new rivalries, and that classic ‘everyone begins together’ feeling, this one’s for you. More details will be shared closer to launch – get ready to jump back into the race!

[h2]Seasonal Events[/h2]
No worries here, your favourite traditions are staying right where they belong. As always, you can expect Lunar New Year, Valentine, Easter and Imp Raid events.

[h2]More Soon[/h2]
That’s the roadmap teaser for now! We’ll go deeper into each feature as we get closer to release, with proper patch notes and full news announcements. Until then, gather your family, sharpen your specialist cards, and get ready for what’s next.

And remember: just like Santa, we might still have a few surprises hidden in our bag…

Merry Christmas!
The NosTale Team

titre: Events: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b15ef62a7db6e27bf962710319cc8068b56026de.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]12/12 (11 AM) and 15/12 (11 AM CET)[/b], you have a [b]50% improved chance[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: Act 10 – Dimensional Tales
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c978d2905d85fe4e5472a96bc2109adbf9aa6f00.jpg[/img]

The wait is over – Act 10 is finally here! Play the new update today and embark on a grand adventure in unexplored dimensions, discovering strange new worlds and encountering brand-new dangers! Plus enjoy a raft of new features, exciting raids, brand-new equipment, and festive winter events as the year draws to a close!

[h3]Act 10 – Dimensional Tales[/h3]

In his new laboratory deep inside Undercity, Techron introduces you to the mysterious scientist Doctor Dimensio. Allow yourself to whisked away on a journey to strange dimensions, in a quest to stop the terrifying Nezarun, the Devourer of Dimensions, and rescue the world of NosTale! The new quest series starts in Dimensio’s Lab in Undercity.

[h3]New Adventures[/h3]

Explore 12 new maps and 2 new raids, where tons of challenges and new quests await! Face over 50 new monsters (including 2 raid bosses) and battle your way through 24 new Time-Spaces. As ever, you’ll find a host of new weapons, armour, accessories and more to help you on your journey. Plus it’s now possible to reach champion level 99!

[b]Two New Raids[/b]
Put your skills to the test in the Nezarun and Crusher Nezarun raids! You and your companions will have to hone your skills and teamwork in order to master the new mechanics and overcome these challenges. Will your team soar through victorious? Or will you all plunge into chaos together? Find out today!

[h3]Enhanced Upgrade System[/h3]

In order to ensure you are well equipped for these new adventures, you can now level up your gear to +13 and make it stronger than ever before! Each level even has its own glow effect. The chances of success when upgrading to +9 and +10 have been increased, while the upgrades are guaranteed after a certain number of failed attempts when upgrading to +11 through +13!

[h3]Winter Events[/h3]

As befitting the cold winter months, you can engage in the [b]Tiger Maru Raid[/b], [b]Snowman Raid[/b] and [b]Letter Collecting Event[/b]! Complete special quests, put your skills to the test against winter bosses, marvel at the festive decorations, and pick up exclusive rewards. Celebrate the end of the year with us and get your hands on festive items, costumes and buffs!
Plus you’ll find an array of special offers and items in a special [b]Christmas Market[/b] area of the NosMall!

[h3]More Details[/h3]

Do you want to learn more? Then read through our [url=https://gameforge.com/play/nostale/news/1a4c8d9b-d890-4fab-86a8-c2479ee62e09]exhaustive patch notes[/url] or the announcement post [url=https://gameforge.com/play/nostale/news/c7389855-0b90-4eca-a286-9789193dc66b]here[/url] .

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: Winter in NosTale
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e7692bedd366bd72afd1609a5e22ecc31cf57310.jpg[/img]

As you know, winter can get very cold and dreary. But not in your favourite game! In NosTale, you can expect lots of exciting events that you can hugely benefit from. Between, [b]10th December and 14th January[/b], you can look forward to a number of events such as our winter raids, special quests, awesome gifts and much more!

[h2]Winter Raids[/h2]

[b]Maru the Millennial Tiger Raid[/b]

Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the Doppelgänger title as well as the Completion Gemstone Random Box.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

[b]Snowman Raid[/b]

Take revenge on the snow monster for the Vikings – grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward for beating this exciting raid, you’ll earn a raid box containing specialist partner cards, the Sleepy Head title and other wintry event items.

[h2]Winter Quests[/h2]

[b]Daily Quests[/b]
[list]
[*]Searching for the Siblings’ Mother
[*]Save the Siblings
[*]Need Sesame Oil
[/list]
You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.

[b]Event Quest[/b]

In these quests you can talk to the Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the wonderful items hidden inside.

[b]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil[/b]

Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

[b]Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille[/b]

Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

[b]Happy New Year… Literally![/b]

Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words [b]HAPPY NEW YEAR[/b], you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If you’re lucky, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes, or a variety of fireworks inside.

[h2]Winter Surprises[/h2]

[b]Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer[/b]

Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

[b]Specialist Partners[/b]

With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger.
With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power.

[b]Holiday Offers in the NosMall[/b]

Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – grab the [b]Christmas Tree Pack[/b] full of wonderful items for the holidays!

[b]Advent Calendar in Daily Loyalty Bonus[/b]

Many festive doors are waiting to be opened by you! Between [b]1st December (11 AM) and 25th December (11 AM CET)[/b] you can look forward to special gifts in the daily loyalty bonus. Get into the festive Christmas spirit and pick up presents!

[b]How It Works:[/b]
[list]
[*]Log in daily, open a field in the NosMall and find out which surprise is waiting for you today!
[*]During the time frame, you can get [b]special gifts[/b] on weekends as well as one [b]super surprise[/b] on Christmas Eve.
[*]Remember to log in every day to get your hands on as many special gifts as you can.
[*]Please note that the regular daily loyalty bonus gifts will not be given out during this time.
[/list]
Wishing you a wonderful winter season!
The NosTale Team

titre: Act 10: Dimensional Tales – Patch Notes
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg[/img]

The wait is nearly over, as Act 10 – Dimensional Tales launches on 10th December.
[list][*]The maximum champion level has been increased from 90 to 99.[list][*]New equipment items, accessories, hats, gloves and boots can be acquired by completing certain raids or via crafting.[/*][*]A new NosBazaar category for champion level 90–99 equipment has been added.[/*][/list][/*][*]Two new raids have been added.[list][*]The Nezarun raid can be entered with 15 players. Minimum level: champion level 90[/*][*]The Crusher Nezarun raid can be entered with 20 players. Minimum level: champion level 90[/*][*]After completing these raids you receive Nezarun’s Hair and Nezarun’s Dimensiolith. These can be exchanged for great rewards.[/*][*]Two new family missions have been added for these raids.[/*][*]At the launch of Act 10, these will have a daily limit which will later be removed.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new main quest has been added.[list][*]This main quest can be started with Mullan in Undercity. If you already completed the Act 9 main quest, please relog to properly start the Act 10 main quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]New passive skill books can be received from map bosses in Act 10.[/*][*]Equipment upgrades have been expanded.[list][*]Main weapons, secondary weapons and armour can now be upgraded to level +13 to unlock even more powerful bonuses. The visual effects change depending on upgrade level.[/*][list][*]+11 = 225% bonus damage (turquoise)[/*][*]+12 = 245% bonus damage (yellow)[/*][*]+13 = 300% bonus damage (purple)[/*][/list][*]A global message will appear when equipment is upgraded to +10 or higher.[/*][*]New slots have been added to the NosBazaar for upgrades +11 to +13.[/*][*]The chances for +9 and +10 have been increased.[/*][/list][/*][*]Pets can now also reach attack and defence level 13.[/*][*]A pity system has also been introduced with the equipment upgrade expansion.[list][*]Every failed upgrade attempt adds to the pity gauge.[/*][*]Once the pity gauge is full, the next upgrade is guaranteed to be successful.[/*][*]The pity gauge remains when trading.[/*][*]The pity system is only available for upgrades +11 to 13.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new loading screen and background image have been added to suit the Act 10 content.[/*][*]The Tart Hapendam’s Heroic Martial Arts buff is now active from champion level 1–79 instead of 1–59.[/*][*]Reduced the cost of equipment and accessory scrolls, as well as gloves/shoes crafted with Pollutus Cores and Giant Arma’s Power Source, by ~50%.[/*][*]The costs for creating equipment and accessories have been reduced (except for fairies).[/*][*]The chance for passive skill books in Act 9 has been drastically increased.[/*][*]Pets and partners suffer less damage in Act 10.[/*][*]General drops like vegetables and apples have been removed in Act 10.[/*][*]Steam Drones also earn fairy experience in Act 10 maps.[/*][*]Start of the Winter Event:[list][*]The Snowman and Maru raids are now only available from level 65. This also applies to the winter quests.[/*][*]NosVille, Port Alveus and Minilands are now covered in snow.[/*][/list][/*][*]It is now possible to zoom out further on Ultimate Giant Arma and Weak Asgobas in the new raids.[/*][*]The UI element which appears after selecting a target has been enlarged.[/*][*]It is now possible to create Cella Powder in big amounts at Malcolm Mix.[/*][*]The following pet trainers now have magic attacks: Rudolph's Pet Trainer, Samurai Pet Trainer, Pirate Pet Trainer, Scary Pet Trainer, Strong Bushi Trainer, Bushtail Trainer[/*][/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the UI would disappear if there were too many items on the floor.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where too many debuffs would crash the client.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where violation errors appeared when selecting targets with too many debuffs.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where NosMates could have a higher level than 99.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where characters could wear partner equipment.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where buffs without a duration wouldn’t display icons in certain cases.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Raid leader could not see character icons in raids with 20 or more people.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where information windows were empty.[/*][/list]

titre: Act 10 – Dimensional Tales
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c978d2905d85fe4e5472a96bc2109adbf9aa6f00.jpg[/img]

Unfamiliar worlds are waiting to be discovered! New realms of possibility open up in NosTale on [i]10th December 2025[/i] with the launch of [b]Act 10 – Dimensional Tales[/b]. Venture into unexplored dimensions, face new opponents and discover strange worlds on the brink of collapse. You can also enjoy a raft of new features, exciting raids, brand-new gear, plus festive winter events as the year draws to a close!

[h3]The Story[/h3]

Deep within Undercity, Techron has set up a new laboratory. Rumour has it that he has invented a revolutionary new machine. In his lab you’ll meet a mysterious scientist: Doctor Dimensio.

She hails from a highly advanced society which developed the technology to travel between parallel dimensions. But she brings word of a terrifying enemy – Nezarun, Devourer of Dimensions – whose forces have already destroyed countless worlds.
Nezarun leeches energy from these worlds to become ever more powerful, and now the world of NosTale threatens to fall into his evil clutches.

Working together with Techron and Doctor Dimensio, you must stabilise the fragile barrier between the dimensions, fend off the invading army, and stop this world becoming the dimension eater’s next victim.

[h3]New Areas and Dimensions[/h3]

Act 10 unlocks access to a variety of new maps and dimensions:

[b]New Worlds & Dimensions[/b]

[i] 12 new maps, including [/i]Dimensio’s Lab* which can be accessed via the portal in Undercity
[list]
[*]2 new raids
[*]Over 50 new monsters and 2 raid bosses
[*]24 new Time-Spaces
[/list]More info about Act10 is coming soon!

[h3]Winter Events[/h3]

A festive atmosphere falls on NosVille for the cold winter months! Look forward to the [b]Maru Raid[/b], the [b]Snowman Raid[/b] and the [b]Letter Collecting Event[/b] for the New Year, giving you special quests, bosses, festive decorations and exclusive rewards. Celebrate the end of the year in NosTale style and pick up festive items, costumes and buffs!
Plus you’ll find an array of special offers and items in a special [b]Christmas Market[/b] area of the NosMall!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: End of the NosVersary Server & Server Merge
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/64df2f5db3966060bcd8b2698fad3609d557b0c0.jpg[/img]

Our NosVersary event server is coming to a close, and as announced when we launched the server, there will be a NosVersary server merge on [b]Wednesday, 19th November 2025[/b]. If you haven’t done so already, remember to select your destination server for the character transfer this week!

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How do I choose a server?[/h3]

The Battle Pass gives you access to a box with two items that allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item represents a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you only have until the NosVersary server closes to choose your destination server.

[h3]What happens if I don’t have any free character slots on the regular server?[/h3]

You have a total of four character slots available. If you have used up all your slots on the destination server but still want to transfer your selected NosVersary character there, don’t worry, none of your characters on the destination server will be lost, they will only be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.

[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?[/h3]

Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
[list]
[*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
[*]Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
[*]If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.
[*]Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists.
[/list]
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

If you’re playing on Steam, you’ll need to link your Steam account with your Gameforge account in order to manage your active characters. [Click here] ([url=https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/348-from-steam-to-gameforge-how-to-link-accounts/]https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/348-from-steam-to-gameforge-how-to-link-accounts/[/url]) to find out how it works.

[h3]What happens to families?[/h3]

Families will not be transferred to the target server.

[h3]What happens to the family warehouse?[/h3]

Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel.

[h3]What if two or more characters have the same name?[/h3]

Destination server characters can keep their names. Characters transferred to this server may need to be renamed.
If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

[h3]What if I have more than 2,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?[/h3]

As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 2,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de]our Support team[/url].

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?[/h3]

Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?[/h3]

Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your transferred character.

[h3]What happens to auctions in the NosBazaar?[/h3]

All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.
Inactive auctions must be collected before the server closes, though, otherwise the items will be deleted. If you’ve lost an item for this reason, please contact our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de]support team[/url].

[h3]What happens to friend lists and spouses?[/h3]

Friend lists will be deleted and marriages ended.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]

No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?[/h3]

The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?[/h3]

Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]What about my Miniland?[/h3]

All your pets, partners and Miniland decorations will be transferred to the destination server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]

No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]

No, you can log in as usual with your credentials.

titre: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e1b4480b04b6d90c325fe2a4f63deab4f0b67e8d.jpg[/img]

Get ready: from [b]29th October to 19th November 2025[/b], NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An [b]additional quest[/b] and a [b]title with powerful effects[/b] are also waiting for you!

[h1]Event Raids[/h1]

[h3]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h3]

Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.
Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

[h3]Foxy and Her Brood[/h3]

Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!
Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a powerful partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

[h3]Mad Professor Macavity[/h3]

The mad genius feline is back! Rally seven players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!

[b]Full details on the raid:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.
[*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.
[*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.
[*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.
[*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.
[*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.
[*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time.
[*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.
[*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.
[*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.
[*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
[/list]
[h3]Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects[/h3]

In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
[list]
[*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.
[*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.
[*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
[/list]

[h3]The Cursed 13[/h3]

Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

[h3]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/h3]

Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
[list]
[*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.
[*]Don your Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.
[*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
[/list]

Pick your favourite monstrous costume and give enemies a good scare: during the event period, the new [b]Spirit Guide Costume[/b] will be available in the NosMall.

titre: NosVersary Event: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
texte:

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]21/10 (11 AM) and 24/10 (11 AM CEST)[/b], you have a [b]150% improved chance[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

Please note that this event is [b]exclusive to the NosVersary server[/b].

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

[h3]Top Anniversary Events on All Servers[/h3]

In addition to our exclusive anniversary server, we also have a ton of anniversary action lined up for you on all other servers! There’s an [b]anniversary calendar with gifts[/b], the [b]letter collecting event[/b], a [b]fan art contest[/b] with top prizes and much more to look forward to!

[h3]NosVersary FAQ[/h3]

Find out everything you need to know about the [b]NosVersary event server[/b] here!

[b]How long will NosVersary be online before I can transfer registered characters?[/b]
[list]
[*]NosVersary will be online for 6 weeks, from 24th September until 5th November 2025.
[/list]
[b]What’s special about NosVersary?[/b]
[list]
[*]Once you’ve selected a class, various character-bound items will be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 21+5.
[*]Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.
[*]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosVersary event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
[*]You’ll find copies of the most popular levelling maps on the maps themselves.
[*]You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.
[/list]
[b]How do I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Characters are not transferred automatically.
[*]Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards.
[*]Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. So don’t forget to select a server to transfer to.
[/list]
[b]How do I choose a server?[/b]
[list]
[*]There will be two different items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item will represent a different destination server.
[*]The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosVersary event server closes to choose your destination server.
[/list]
[b]Where do I see which server I’ve selected?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).
[/list]
[b]Can I transfer my items with my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window), plus the regular and equipment inventories, will automatically transfer with them. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character.
[*]Items from the warehouse, unlocked NosMall items, and active offers in the NosBazaar will be sent to you by parcel.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, there will be a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] for the NosVersary server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
[*]The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: Caligor’s Spirit, upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, and transfer items.
[/list]
[b]Are there any rules for transferring?[/b]
[list]
[*]Similar transfer rules will apply as for last year’s Summer Oasis. Details will be published in a separate FAQ news post.
[/list]
[b]Which boosts will be available and when?[/b]
[list]
[*]The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosVersary server:
[*]2x EXP (3x on some weekends)
[*]2x Drops (3x on some weekends)
[*]2x Gold
[*]3x Fairy XP
[*]2x EXP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
[*]2x Family XP
[*]4x Reputation
[*]In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.
[/list]
[b]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the regular servers will have similar events to NosVersary, though they will differ from the NosVersary events.
[/list]
[b]Can I change the name of my character on the NosVersary event server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to restrictions being placed on your account. Please keep this in mind while choosing your character’s name.
[/list]
Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: Events: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b15ef62a7db6e27bf962710319cc8068b56026de.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]12/09 (11 AM) and 15/09 (11 AM CEST)[/b], you have a [b]50% improved chance[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

titre: Celestial Spire Catacombs: The Family Challenge Awaits
texte:

It’s time for a new chapter in your destiny, as the Celestial Spire Catacombs call out to you… and this time, you will not be alone. Rally your family around you and venture into the depths together in the latest challenging group mode in NosTale from [b]10th September 2025 (11 AM CEST)[/b].

Master a tactical tower defence experience, with new maps, dangerous monsters and increasing difficulty. Join forces to protect the totem from the forces of darkness – and remember that a single mistake could spell your doom!

[h3]New: Family Mode in the Celestial Spire Catacombs[/h3]

Descend the Celestial Spire Catacombs with your family. Access to the new zone is granted via the Celestial Spire Catacombs Manager NPC in Act 9, located in Undercity. Here’s where your journey through the 20 levels of the Celestial Spire Catacombs begins.

[b]Access & Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Only champion level 80+ characters can participate
[*]Weekly limit: 50 entries
[*]Every family member can open levels
[*]Groups consist of 8 to 12 players, and multiple teams can enter simultaneously
[*]Only previously unlocked levels are accessible
[*]Levels 1 through 20 are unlocked in turn via family progress
[*]Monthly reset: Every month you must start your descent afresh; your progress will be reset, and the challenge starts from the beginning
[/list]
[b]Mechanics: Defend the Totem[/b]
[list]
[*]The totem is at the heart of the action; if this is destroyed, your attempt fails.
[*]Monsters will appear in increasingly difficult waves, attacking from random directions, with more monsters appearing the more companions you have.
[*]Special effects and other dangers such as meteor showers and other mechanics make each level unique.
[*]Should a player die, they can respawn on the same level using a Celestial Spire Catacombs First-Aid Kit. If they choose not to do this, or the whole team dies, then the entry is spent.
[/list]
[b]Rewards & Progress[/b]
Each successfully completed level affords:
[list]
[*]Catacomb Tokens redeemable in the new token shop for:
[*]New pets
[*]Handy consumables
[*]... and more!
[/list]
[b]Missions & Quests[/b]
Besides fame and glory, you can expect:
[list]
[*]Weekly family missions with buffs for all members (e.g. EXP bonuses)
[*]Daily and monthly family missions
[*]Personal weekly tasks
[*]Unique family quests which unlock powerful rewards upon completion
[*]Monthly rankings
[*]General quest line inspired by the Pet Trainer quests. Earn powerful rewards upon completion!
[*]Future Battle Pass missions!
[/list]
Are you ready for the ultimate family challenge? Then gear up, round up your allies, and face the greatest challenge yet. March on – step by step, level for level – to victory!

Best of luck,
The NosTale Team

texte:

It’s been a while, but we’re now back with the family edition of the Celestial Spire – the Celestial Spire Catacombs!

Prepare for this thrilling adventure and battle your way through all the levels with your family.

[h2]The Celestial Spire Catacombs:[/h2]
[b]General rules:[/b]
[list][*]Champion level 80+[/*][*]8–12 players[/*][*]Initial weekly limit of 50 entries[/*][*]Entry via a new NPC in Undercity[/*][*]Progress resets monthly[/*][*]New skill for entering the Celestial Spire Catacombs, similar to the Raid List (the leader must start the expedition with the NPC)[/*][/list]
[b]Combat system rules:[/b]
[list][*]Monsters get stronger each level[/*][*]Six lives with 1 totem to defend; if all your lives are used up, or the totem is destroyed, you fail to complete the level[/*][*]The more team members present, the more monsters will appear[/*][*]There are currently no squads in the Celestial Spire Catacombs[/*][*]It is possible to resurrect in a level using a special item[/*][/list]
[b]Rewards and missions:[/b] (https://nostale.comastuff.com/Celestial_Spire_Catacombs.pdf, only in english)
[list][*]Level rewards: [list][*]Random rewards for completing a level[/*][*]One-time monthly rewards for first completing a level[/*][*]Guaranteed rewards for completing a level[/*][/list][/*][*]Monthly family rewards: [list][*]Passive buffs which reset on the 1st of every month[/*][*]Passive buffs to increase damage and defence, skills for double drops, and more[/*][/list][/*][*]Unique family quests: [list][*]Quests awarding FXP[/*][*]Permanent passive buffs for reducing family expansion costs and more[/*][/list][/*][*]Daily family quests: [list][*]Daily quests awarding FXP[/*][/list][/*][*]Monthly rankings: [list][*]Families compete according to levels and time, and receive rewards based for their rank at the beginning of the month[/*][/list][/*][*]Unique weekly missions (found in the Progress Book): [list][*]Quests which provide materials and Celestial Spire Catacombs Tokens[/*][/list][/*][*]Celestial Spire Catacombs Token Shop: [list][*]You can exchange Celestial Spire Catacombs Tokens for various items such as:[/*][*]Resistances, passive skill books, new pets and more[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]General changes:[/b]
[list][*]Added a Celestial Spire Catacombs Team Stone to the Alchemist in Undercity[/*][*]It is no longer possible to heal the totem in the regular Celestial Spire[/*][*]Added an overview of raid team members, visible when clicking on a team in the Raid List[/*][/list]
[b]Clarifications:[/b]
[list]
[*] The entry count for the Celestial Spire Catacombs is reduced the moment the stage lever is pulled, not when you or your team fails.
[*] Celestial Spire Catacombs Level progress is individual, through the help of your family, not based on your family's highest progress.
[*] If you die, you will lay on the ground for another 60 seconds. If your team clears the level during this time, the run will also count as successful for you. If the team clears the level after 60 or more seconds since your death, it will count as a fail for you.
[*] The effect "HP is increased by x% of damage given" is deactivated inside the Celestial spire catacombs
[*] There is no MP consumption in the Celestial spire catacombs.
[/list]

Yo-ho-ho, Captain Pete O’Peng is back! After voyaging the seven seas, he’s returned… and he’s badder than ever before! Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[b]What Else?[/b]
There are also lots of other missions that need your attention. In reward for your efforts, you can pick up the [b]Lopears[/b] title giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute Bunny Hairband, and a whole raft of other rewards.

texte:

[h2]How the NosTombola Works[/h2]
Every player may take part in the NosTombola. It can be found in the NosMall in the game. There you can use tickets to win amazing prizes! Each ticket grants either one of the valuable daily jackpot prizes, a lucky token or an item as a direct prize.
[list][*]You can purchase 10 tickets for NosJewels every day.[/*][*]Up to 6 tickets can also be purchased at a slightly cheaper price for the following day.[/*][*]Each new day of the NosTombola begins at 4 AM CEST.[/*][/list]
[h3]Precious NosJewels[/h3]
For each purchase in the NosMall, you will be credited a certain number of NosJewels. The number of NosJewels you receive can be seen in the details in the NosMall.

You can use the NosJewels to purchase tickets, or to buy items directly in the Jewel Shop. The more tickets you use, the greater your chances to get the current day’s jackpot.

[h3]Free Daily Ticket[/h3]
Don’t miss your free ticket! You can get one of these every day per account if you have completed the main quest line of Act 4 (before the start of the tombola), [b]or[/b] if you have purchased at least one ticket for three days in a row.

[h3]The Lucky Tokens[/h3]
Some of the tickets have lucky tokens behind them for you to collect. Every three tokens can be exchanged for a prize. Once you collect three lucky tokens, you will receive the corresponding prize according to the total points. You can only use more tickets once this prize has been redeemed. Alternatively you can re-roll your three tokens, however this costs 20 NosDollars.

You can receive these and many other items with the lucky tokens:
[list][*]Divine Shell Upgrade[/*][*]Christmas Tree Wings[/*][*]Champion Amulet for Increasing Rarity[/*][*]Shadow Element Steam Drone[/*][/list]

titre: Event: Lord Melonoth’s Summer Raid
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d9ae25b0d1d7bb8825553fd9f1e7141f015c7383.jpg[/img]

Get ready for a fruitastic challenge this summer! Battle against fruity monsters like Bananosaurus and Dragon Fruitlets, then defeat Lord Melonoth himself in the brand-new summer raid!

Rewards such as little fruit pets, an additional mini pet, the Fruity Ninja title and much more await!

[b]Running[/b]: 23rd July (11 AM) to 20th August (11 AM CEST)

[h3]The Story So Far[/h3]

Some time ago, the Mullans of Undercity started to trade with people from the surface. These new dealings gave the Mullans their first taste of fresh fruit! One tribe member, by the name of Doctor Frox, was munching down on some of this fruit from the surface, and became absolutely obsessed with the taste.

He focused all of his energies on cultivating varieties of fruit plants which would be capable of surviving in the darkness of Undercity. He set up [i]Frox’s Fruit Lab[/i] as a research institute and started a number of botanical experiments. Using a specially developed serum, Doctor Frox wanted to promote growth in his plants.
The first results were fruitful, and his plants flourished despite the total darkness. But something went wrong... the serum had some unexpected side effects. The plants mutated, outgrowing their natural size and becoming intelligent – and hostile!
The fruit monsters broke out of the laboratory and made their way to the surface, where they started to attack the surrounding settlements.

Riddled with guilt, Doctor Frox has followed them to the surface, and is now searching for help. He needs someone who is courageous and strong enough to stop these unbridled creatures, before they can plunge the surface into chaos.

[h3]Raid Info[/h3]

In order to participate in the Lord Melonoth Raid, you must first complete the Time-Space quest Lab on Alert. Only the raid leader needs Lord Melonoth’s Raid Seal to start the raid.

You also receive the Fresh Melon Rind (Event) in reward which allows you to deal double damage to the mini-bosses and the raid boss.

The Time-Space quest can be completed up to 5 times per day. The raid can be entered via Fruit Fiend Portal in NosVille.

A maximum of 15 players can participate in a raid. Players must face a platter of fruity enemies to defeat, followed by Lord Melonoth himself, before they can get the amazing rewards from his raid box.

[b]Raid Box of Lord Melonoth[/b]
The box can contain these items:
[list]

[*]1x Gleaming Melon Stone

[*]1x Special Fruit

[/list]
You can also loot various items from the fruity monsters during the event which can be exchanged for the following rewards from Doctor Frox:
[list]

[*]1x Mini Dapplodocus

Grab your fruit knife and get slicing that feisty fruit into a tasty salad!

titre: Community Update – Second Half of 2025
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Dear NosPlayers,

Summer is already here, and things are heating up in NosTale! As the days get longer and the temperatures rise, it’s time to reflect on what’s happened so far in 2025 and give you a sneak peek at what’s coming next. From major updates to blazing new servers and exciting plans for the months ahead – let’s dive in!

[h1]A Look Back: January–June 2025[/h1]
[h2]Early Game Rework & Balancing[/h2]
One of the most significant changes this year was our rework of the early game experience. Aimed at improving the onboarding process for new and returning players, this update brought a series of quality-of-life adjustments, revamped quest flows, and combat balancing tweaks to make early-level progression more fluid and enjoyable.

If you haven’t had the chance to check it out yet, we highly recommend taking a look at the [url=https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/2604-game-update-maintenance-19-03-2025/?postID=6060#post6060]patch notes[/url] or diving into the [url=https://nostale.comastuff.com/Early_Game_Rework.pdf]detailed rework document[/url] to get the full picture.

[h2]NosFire Event Server[/h2]
March also saw the launch of [b]NosFire[/b], our limited-time event server filled with explosive action and intense boosts. Players jumped in to enjoy increased EXP and drop rates, unique progression opportunities, and a fast-paced environment that brought a fresh twist to the classic NosTale experience.

NosFire was a hit, and we’re thrilled to see how many of you took part. Whether it was for competitive goals or just to experience the rush, thank you for being part of the fun!

[h1]Looking Ahead: July–December 2025[/h1]
[h2]Server Merge Incoming![/h2]
As you already know by now, one of the first updates planned for the summer is the [b]merge of three major servers: INT-Valehir, DE-Alzanor, and FR-Cosmos[/b]. This merge will bring communities together, strengthen server populations, and create a more dynamic and competitive environment.

[h2]Summer Events – New Raid, New Adventures![/h2]
Our annual summer events return with a splash – not only can you enjoy our usual events to get your hands on hot and cool rewards, but this year, an original new event will also be deployed on our servers bringing a [b]brand-new raid and quests[/b] as well! Expect challenging adventures against the new raid boss, succulent rewards, and all the summer vibes you can get. Prepare your team and dive into this juicy seasonal adventure!

[h2]New Content – Family Celestial Spire[/h2]
Although we announced it for the first half of the year, we were sadly unable to release it on time. However, this time we’re happy to confirm that the Family Celestial Spire is now on track for release. Families will be put to the test with the introduction of the [b]Family Ascension of the Celestial Spire[/b] – a return to the Celestial Spire from Act 7, designed for cooperative gameplay. Climb the tower together, overcome increasingly difficult floors, and earn rewards worthy of your efforts.

[h2]Anniversary Celebrations – New Temporary Celebration Server[/h2]
To mark another year of NosTale, we’re launching a [b]special temporary anniversary server[/b] packed with unique features and limited-time bonuses. Not only will you be able to enjoy the usual birthday events early this year on all servers, but you’ll also receive even more presents on the temporary server. Like NosFire, this server will also allow you to transfer your character at the end of the event – fully prepared for the major content update coming later this year!

Because remember – Christmas is still to come… and if you’re really good, Santa might bring you a really big present.

[h2]Final Words[/h2]
As always, we’d like to thank every one of you for your continued support and feedback. Whether you’ve been here from the start, or are just beginning your journey in NosTale, your passion helps shape the future of the game.

See you in the game!
The NosTale Team

titre: Server Merge: Alzanor, Cosmos & Valehir
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/12383fee94c3cbc9420f72d81942634c7ab467aa.jpg[/img]

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. We always want to ensure that you can play on servers with lots of activity. For that reason, we have decided to carry out a merge of the European servers on [b]16th July[/b].

You’ll find a [b]Merge FAQ[/b] below which should answer any important questions you may have.

[b]The following servers are being merged together:[/b]
[list]
[*]DE-Alzanor
[*]FR-Cosmos
[*]INT-Valehir
[/list]
[b]→ EU-Undercity[/b]

No changes will be made to the other server.

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How did you decide which servers to merge together?[/h3]

We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

[h3]What happens if I have multiple characters on both servers which are being merged together?[/h3]

You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.

Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):

[b]Situation 1[/b]: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.

[b]Situation 2[/b]: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters.

[b]Situation 3[/b]: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[b]Situation 4[/b]: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[b]Situation 5[/b]: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?[/h3]

Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
[list]
[*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
[*]Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
[*]If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.
[*]Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists.
[/list]
You can change your active characters on the website at any time. This is also possible for players playing via NosTale.

[h3]What happens to families?[/h3]

Active families will be transferred to the target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

[h3]What happens to the family warehouse?[/h3]

Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel.

[h3]What if two or more characters have the same name?[/h3]

The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.

If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.

Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

[h3]What happens when two or more families have the same name?[/h3]

If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘<servernumber>\_<familyname>’. Please contact the [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de]Support team[/url] to change the family name manually.

[h3]What if I have more than 2,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?[/h3]

As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 2,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de]our Support team[/url].

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?[/h3]

Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?[/h3]

Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character.

[h3]What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?[/h3]

All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

[h3]What happens to friend lists and spouses?[/h3]

As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target server.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]

No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?[/h3]

The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?[/h3]

Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge.

[h3]Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?[/h3]

No, your characters will be activated automatically.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?[/h3]

Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]

No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]

No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

If you have any further questions, our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=de]Support team[/url] will be happy to help.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

titre: Information about the closure of the NosFire server
texte: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/55be90cfa9d48d9eb2287d3d69909cf7ff8e9864.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear NosPlayers,[/p][p][/p][p]We want to remind you that the NosFire server will soon be closed. We originally announced its closure for the 18th of June, but to give you a bit more time to finish the necessary tasks, we will prolong the duration of the server and now it will be closing on the 24th of June instead.[/p][p][/p][p]Players that reached the 700BP points reward will be able to pick a target server they want to be merged to at the end of NosFire. Please use the transfer item and choose the target server of your choice as soon as possible, since it will not be possible anymore on the 24th of June.[/p][p][/p][p]If you also unlocked the warehouse item in the Battle Pass, please use it in advance as well, so you can pick the 10 additional items you want to have merged together with your equipment and the items mentioned in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/550470/view/515206275424846030?l=english"]FAQ[/url]. Remember: All items your character has currently equipped (in the P-menu) at the moment of the merge will be transferred automatically, including costume inventory, SP card inventory, active pets, active partners with their equipped items as well, and active Mall items like inventory expansions or NosMerchant medals. Everything else will not be transferred.[/p][p][/p][p]All other characters that did not earn enough Battle Pass points to get the transfer item will be unavailable after the end of NosFire. You can find all details about the rules and restrictions concerning the NosFire merge in the official [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/550470/view/515206275424846030?l=english"]FAQ[/url] in our forums.[/p][p][/p][p]One last point we want to inform you about is, that soon after the NosFire server has been merged, we will be taking care of the already announced merge of INT-Valehir, DE-Alzanor and FR-Cosmos, so you will not have to wait much longer for it. Take this into account when deciding which server to choose![/p][p][/p][p]As soon as we have a more concrete date to announce for that merge, we will let you know.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the last weeks of NosFire and have fun playing![/p][p]The NosTale Team[/p]

titre: NosFire Event Server: Burning Hot Boosts & Action
texte:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/55be90cfa9d48d9eb2287d3d69909cf7ff8e9864.jpg[/img]

This spring promises to be full of exciting NosTale adventures! As the Sun sends out its first warm rays of the year, we’re ready to respond with some scorching hot action. Get ready for the [b]brand-new NosFire event server[/b] where you can level up a character faster than ever before, take advantage of events and boosts, as well as lots of other great benefits!
[list]
[*][b]NosFire Event Server Starts[/b]: 15th April 2025
[*][b]NosFire Event Server Ends[/b]: 18th June 2025
[/list]
[h3]What to expect on the NosFire Event Server:[/h3]
[list]
[*]You’ll start at [b]level 80[/b] and get access to [b]double EXP, double gold drops[/b], and more!
[*]You’ll get a [b]free equipment set[/b] when you start your NosFire event server adventure!
[*]Take part in [b]boost events and weekend specials[/b] and make the most out of the event server!
[*][b]Brand new this year[/b]: The [b]Progress Book[/b]! Use it for a chance to get valuable rewards!
[*]Complete missions and snag some powerful rewards with the [b]new Battle Pass[/b]!
[*][b]When the event server ends, migrate your new character to a regular server with a free character transfer[/b] and keep rocking your adventures there!
[*]... and much more!
[/list]
[h3]FAQ[/h3]

Find out everything you need to know about the [b]NosFire event server[/b] here!

[b]How long will NosFire be online before I can transfer registered characters?[/b]
[list]
[*]NosFire will be online for 9 weeks, from 15/4 until 18/6/2025.
[/list]
[b]What’s special about NosFire?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can select a class in the character selection window and start at level 80/job level 80 right away.
[*]Once you’ve selected a class, various character-bound items will be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 50+5.
[*]Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.
[*]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosFire event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
[*][b]New[/b]: You will have access to a Progress Book that will offer you lots of valuable rewards on your journey through NosFire. It works similarly to how the Pet Book works, and will allow you to access various quests from directly within the game. You can claim your rewards directly after completing the quests.
[*]You’ll find copies of the most popular levelling maps on the maps themselves.
[*]Certain content, such as Act 8 raids, will be simplified, and the entry level for certain raids will be adjusted.
[*]Cannot craft or purchase warehouses from NPCs.
[*]Adjusted the entry level for certain Time-Spaces.
[*]Cannot earn gold from the SP 1+2 Martial Artist quest.
[*]Adjusted the entry level for Instant Combats and Rainbow Battles to level 85. Level 85+ can now access minigames.
[*]Cannot sell or trade starting equipment.
[*]You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.
[/list]
[b]How do I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. So don’t forget to select a server to transfer to.
[/list]
[b]How do I choose a server?[/b]
[list]
[*]There will be various items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item will represent a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosFire event server closes to choose your destination server.
[/list]
[b]Where do I see which server I’ve selected?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).
[/list]
[b]Are you planning a server merge soon?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, but we don’t have an exact date yet. We will inform all of you as soon as we have more details for you.
[/list]
[b]Can I take my items with me when I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.
[*]Please remember to collect all your rewards from your Battle Pass, Progress Book, and from any post before your character gets transferred. These rewards will no longer be available once the transfer is complete.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, there will be a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] for the NosFire server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
[*]The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, transfer items, and the item transfer warehouse.
[/list]
[b]Are there rules for transferring a character?[/b]
Yes. The following rules apply:
[list]
[*]You must select a server to transfer your character to before the NosFire event server is closed on 18th June 2025, otherwise you won’t be able to transfer your character. We will PM your character multiple times, reminding you to transfer your character before it is no longer possible to.
[*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.
[*]Families will not be transferred and the contents of family warehouses will be deleted.
[*]Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).
[*]Bazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.
[*]The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) apart from the Partner’s Backpack.
[*]Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc., will also be transferred.
[*]If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the first time you log in after transferring.
[*]If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated. You can reactivate them in the standard manner via the website.
[*]Any NosMall items purchased via the website that you do not collect can be collected on the destination server.
[*]Your friends list, blacklist, and marriage will not be transferred.
[*]All parcels (post) will be deleted during the transfer.
[*]Please note: Any rewards you get from the Battle Pass or the Progress Book will not be transferred. Make sure to collect them before transferring.
[/list]
[b]Which boosts will be available and when?[/b]
[list]
[*]The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosFire server:
[*]2x XP
[*]4x Reputation (not in Act 4)
[*]2x XP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
[*]2x Fairy XP
[*]2x Gold
[*]2x Drops
[*]3x Family XP
[*]In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even have multiple events.
[/list]
[b]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the NosFire server, albeit with lower boosts.
[/list]
[b]Will there be an Easter event on every server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the Easter Event will be active on every server (starting 15th April 2025).
[/list]
[b]Will there be special server first challenges?[/b]
[list]
[*]No, there are no server first challenges planned for this event server.
[/list]
[b]Can I change the name of my character on the NosFire event server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to restrictions being placed on your account. Please keep this in mind while choosing your character’s name.
[/list]
Have fun,
The NosTale Team
